name: Aspect of Insects

items.name: Key Weakness
items.text: The King of Biting Ants has long used his force of will to keep his insectile form under control. It has a weakness to arcane spells and occult spells.

items.name: Partitioned Anatomy
items.text:
Trigger The Aspect of Insects would be Confused, Paralyzed, Slowed, or Stunned.

---

Effect The Aspect of Insects confines the debilitating effect to a certain portion of its nervous system, ignoring the effect but causing a maw of its choice to go dormant for the effect's duration. That maw can't be used for a Strike or Breath Weapon during that time. This ability can't be used if all the Aspect of Insects' heads are dormant.

items.name: Spitting Rage
items.text:
Trigger A creature scores a critical hit on the Aspect of Insects.

---

Effect The Aspect of Insects' Breath Weapon recharges. It can use its Breath Weapon immediately as part of this reaction. It can't use this reaction again until it recharges its Breath Weapon naturally.

items.name: Breath Weapon
items.text:
The Aspect of Insects breathes a blast of energy from one of its three heads; each creature in the area must attempt a basic Reflex save.

The Aspect of Insects can't use Breath Weapon again for 1d4 rounds.

- Acid Maw (acid) 10-Foot-Wide, 60-Foot Line of acid dealing 16d8 acid damage (DC 42 basic Reflex save save).

- Flame Maw (fire) 60-foot cone of fire dealing 16d8 fire damage (DC 42 basic Reflex save save).

- Shock Maw (electricity) 120-foot line of electricity dealing 16d8 electricity damage (DC 42 basic Reflex save save).

items.name: Pull Apart
items.text: The Aspect of Insects makes two Strikes with different maws against the same target. If both hit, the target takes an extra 2d12+13 slashing damage, with a DC 42 basic Fortitude save save. On a critical failure, the creature is torn to pieces and dies. The Aspect of Insects' multiple attack penalty increases only after all the attacks are made.

items.name: Thrash
items.text: The Aspect of Insects Strikes once against each creature in its reach. It can Strike up to once with each maw, once with its tail lash, and any number of times with its legs. Each attack takes a -2 circumstance penalty and counts toward the Aspect of Insects' multiple attack penalty, but the multiple attack penalty doesn't increase until after all the attacks are made.

items.name: Trample
items.text:
Huge or smaller, leg, DC 42 basic Reflex save save

---

text: Fearsome centipede-like creatures, mukradis are three-headed predators with a devastating array of breath weapons. A Darklands version of the mukradi is rumored to exist. It's said these variant mukradis have black scales, and all of their heads spew a black, acidic goo that animates before being reabsorbed by the mukradis.
